lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); IN_VAN = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v:teleport(x, z, h); local sc = nova.scene_now(); sc.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h) end; ON_FOOT = function(x, z, face) local v = nova.named('van'); v.driven = false; v:teleport(x + 30, z + 30, 0); local sc = nova.scene_now(); sc.mode = 'foot'; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.seated = false; p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, face; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(face) end; ROAD = function(key) for _, r in ipairs(W.roads) do if r.id == key then return r.points end end end; APPROACH = function(sign, key, dir, cam_d) local s = nova.named(sign); local pts = ROAD(key); local bi, bd = 1, math.huge; for i, p in ipairs(pts) do local d = (p[1] - s.x) ^ 2 + (p[2] - s.z) ^ 2; if d < bd then bi, bd = i, d end end; local want = cam_d - 9.3; local i = bi; local acc = 0; while acc < want and pts[i - dir] do local a, b = pts[i], pts[i - dir]; acc = acc + math.sqrt((a[1] - b[1]) ^ 2 + (a[2] - b[2]) ^ 2); i = i - dir end; local p, q = pts[i], pts[i + dir]; IN_VAN(p[1], p[2], math.atan(q[1] - p[1], q[2] - p[2])); SIGN = s end; AT = function(ex, ey, ez, tx, ty, tz, fov) CAM.pinned = { ex, nova.terrain_height(ex, ez) + ey, ez, tx, nova.terrain_height(tx, tz) + ty, tz, fov or 50 } end; TRAIL = {}
each_frame: if TRACK then local v = nova.named("van"); local x, _, z = v:to_world(0.64, 0, 0.72); TRAIL[#TRAIL + 1] = { x, z }; if #TRAIL % 12 == 0 then nova.scenery.add("flowers", x, 0, z, { shapes = false }) end end

route.lua: IN_VAN(5, -150, 0); local v = nova.named("van"); TRAIL = {}; TRACK = true; AT(5, 21, -155.5, 5, 0, -148.5, 34); v.ctl.steer = 1

route.until: local v = nova.named('van'); v.ctl.go = v.speed < 1.5 and 0.6 or 0; v.ctl.brake = v.speed > 1.7 and 0.3 or 0; v.ctl.steer = 1; return #TRAIL > 60 * 14
